frontend.presentation: Next.js App Router (React Server Components + Client Components). Focus on distinctive frontend-design with polished UI (Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons). Animations via GSAP.
frontend.dataFetching: Custom fetch hooks mapping to existing API patterns (`useEmpleadosData`).
frontend.stateManagement: React state (`useState`) for local component state, and `useEmpleadosModals` hook to manage the state of the ResponsiveSheets.

routing./admin/empleados: List view of employees with data table, kpis, and header.
routing./admin/empleados/[id]: Detailed view of an employee's metrics and history.

backend.services: Business logic separated into `usuario.service.js`. Aggregation of metrics will happen here.
backend.models: Sequelize ORM defining schemas and associations (`Usuario.js`, `Caja.js`, `Pago.js`, `Gasto.js`, `Pedido.js`).

reusableComponents.Overlays: `ResponsiveSheet` from `src/shared/ui/overlays/responsive-sheet.tsx` for forms. Always relying on its automatic responsive behavior (bottom sheet on mobile, side sheet on desktop) without overriding widths.
reusableComponents.Data Display: Dashboard-style KPI cards (reusing patterns from `/admin/dashboard` or `/admin/clientes`) to display total sales, expenses, and active boxes in the detail view.
reusableComponents.Tables: Reusing the application's standard DataTable component structure (as seen in `ClientesTable` and `ServiciosTable`) with sortable headers, pagination, and a global search bar.
reusableComponents.Forms: Standardized inputs, selects, and buttons from the `src/shared/ui` library, integrated with `react-hook-form`.

dependencyAndLibraryDecisions.Form Handling: React Hook Form + Zod for robust client-side validation and accessible forms.
dependencyAndLibraryDecisions.Animations: GSAP (`useGSAP`) for table row staggering and metric card reveals.

failureModesAndEdgeHandling.Network Errors: Show non-blocking toast notifications for API failures. Fallback UI for metric cards when fetch fails.
failureModesAndEdgeHandling.Data Constraints: Handling of unique constraint on `email`. The API must return a 400 error if an email is already registered, and the frontend form must display this field-level error to the user.
failureModesAndEdgeHandling.Zero States: If an employee has never opened a `Caja` or registered a payment, the UI must show an empty state illustration/message.
failureModesAndEdgeHandling.Unauthorized Access: Backend must rigorously verify `negocioId`. An admin attempting to fetch `/api/usuarios/:id/metricas` for a user of another business must receive a 403 Forbidden.

testingStrategyAndQualityGates.Backend: Unit tests for the new `obtenerMetricasUsuario` service method.
testingStrategyAndQualityGates.Frontend: Verify that `ResponsiveSheet` changes layout correctly between mobile and desktop without custom max-width classes breaking it. Ensure navigation to the detail view correctly loads data.
